probeResolutions.1_input_transcription_finalisation: Input transcription finalises synchronously with end-of-speech detection and first output turn frames. Stable text matches ASR ground truth.
probeResolutions.2_session_resumption: Session resumption is fully operational. Server emits sessionResumptionUpdate UUID handles. Reconnecting with handle restores conversation context and state perfectly.
probeResolutions.3_async_tool_results_across_resumption: In-flight tool calls survive session disconnection. Tool response submitted in resumed session with matching call ID is accepted and generated upon.
probeResolutions.4_interaction_status_and_extended_thinki: Extended thinking Live model accepts thinkingConfig: { thinkingLevel: "HIGH" }. Background thoughts are metered in usageMetadata.thoughtsTokenCount. Turn completion signals generation complete.
probeResolutions.5_concurrency_and_rate_limits: Measured zero rate limits (429) across concurrent sessions and multiple rapid connections, corroborating operator-supplied Prepaid Tier 1 allowance (50 concurrent sessions).
